title: Audit the Auditors: Commitment versus Professional Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2609.24020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper provides a theoretical framework to evaluate the trade-off between the self-regulated peer review system and independent government inspection (PCAOB) in the auditing profession. We model the peer review system as a Judgment Regime, where a stakeholder utilizes professional expertise, captured as a private signal, to make ex-post decisions on verifying audit failures. In contrast, PCAOB inspection is modeled as a Commitment Regime, where the stakeholder lacks private information but can commit ex-ante to a predetermined level of verification. We find that the Judgment Regime benefits from a resource-allocation effect and a deterrence effect driven by informed verification, whereas the Commitment Regime deters audit failures through the first-mover advantage of ex-ante commitment. Our analysis demonstrates that the stakeholder prefers the peer review system if and only if the private signal is sufficiently informative. Furtherm

translated_title: 审计审计师：承诺机制与专业判断之权衡
translated_abstract: 本文提供了一个理论框架，用以评估审计行业中自律性同行评审制度与独立政府检查（PCAOB）之间的权衡。我们将同行评审制度建模为“判断机制”，即利益相关者利用以私人信号刻画的专业专长，对审计失败的核查进行事后决策。相比之下，PCAOB检查被建模为“承诺机制”，即利益相关者缺乏私人信息，但可以事前承诺一个预定的核查水平。我们发现，判断机制受益于资源配置效应以及由知情核查所驱动的威慑效应，而承诺机制则通过事前承诺的先发优势来遏制审计失败。我们的分析表明，当且仅当私人信号具有足够的信息量时，利益相关者才会偏好同行评审制度。此外……
tldr: 本文建立理论框架比较审计行业中自律同行评审与独立政府检查（PCAOB）两种监管模式，揭示判断机制兼具资源配置与威慑效应、承诺机制凭借事前承诺的先发优势遏制审计失败，并证明当且仅当私人信号足够有信息量时利益相关者才偏好同行评审制度。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theoretical framework comparing self-regulated peer review with independent government inspection (PCAOB) in auditing, showing that the judgment regime offers resource-allocation and deterrence effects while the commitment regime relies on first-mover advantage, and the stakeholder prefers peer review if and only if the private signal is sufficiently informative.
